description: Fetch a completed project's image as inline MCP image content for compatible clients. Use the exact signed download URL, including query parameters. Requires HTTPS at the configured Magic Hour media host. Read-only; inline content is limited to 8 MiB, or a smaller requested max_bytes. Returns the original-file download link when the media exceeds this limit.

download_url.description: Exact HTTPS URL from a completed project’s downloads or exact_download_urls. Preserve all query parameters; must use the configured Magic Hour media host.

max_bytes.description: Positive maximum inline download bytes, capped at 8388608 bytes (8 MiB). Larger files return an original-file download link.

name: fetch_image_download
title: Fetch Image Download
